name: Romance
source:
Meiji era. The main character is an ambitious novelist. His work is criticized at the redaction, and he is recommended to write romance novels popular with public instead. Hero agrees, but he does not have love experience at all. This is a story of romance birth.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
明治时代，主人公是一名抱负远大的小说家。他的作品在编辑部受到批评，对方建议他改写受大众欢迎的恋爱小说。主人公同意了，却完全没有恋爱经验。这是一个恋爱诞生的故事。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
